events.name: GUI lognormal · refresh after a small change
events.scope: Standard-user GUI. One added file, then each product's fastest refresh until done (WinBlaze incremental rescan, WinDirStat Refresh All, WizTree Scan).

events.name: GUI session · time to first result
events.scope: Standard-user GUI. Launch with the 250k-file lognormal dataset until the first result row is on screen (WinDirStat directory list, WinBlaze results list; WizTree draws rows only once its scan completes).

events.name: GUI session · reload saved results

events.name: GUI session · redraw after resize
events.scope: Standard-user GUI. With the reloaded results shown, resize the window from 1200x800 to 1600x1000 until its screen pixels last change before 400 ms without change (treemap and lists redrawn); each change is timed when its screen capture was taken.
